root_cause: The trial mail promised 'antwoord met afmelden', but the reply loop only looks at senders of its own outreach actions, so a trial customer's opt-out reply was never recorded.
prevention: Before each live run, the sender searches the mailbox for replies from customers who received a trial mail in the last 14 days and adds an active suppression on an opt-out reply. Quoted lines and the own opt-out line do not count.

evidence.runtime_status: unit-tested classifier; live path verified on an empty due list only (no customer mail has been sent yet)

limitations: Only replies within 14 days of the last mail are checked
Free-text opt-outs in other languages are not recognized
